description: Synthetic talking-head monologue with a repeated hook line, a filler-led fragment and two separated moments. Sentence timings are synthetic; the human labels are the moments a reviewer would cut.

sentences.text: Hi everyone, today I want to talk about why most budgets fail.
Did you know that the biggest budget mistake is ignoring small expenses?
Most people skip tracking coffee runs and small subscriptions.
Last year I tracked every single expense for ninety days and the results surprised me.
Small expenses added up to four hundred and twelve dollars a month.
So, um, the first thing I did was cancel three subscriptions I never used.
Here's why that worked: the friction of seeing the number changed my habits.
Anyway, let's move on to the spreadsheet template I use.
Did you know that the biggest budget mistake is ignoring small expenses?
Honestly the template is not important, the habit is everything.
The truth is that nobody tells you how fast a small leak becomes a flood.
That's why I now review every expense on Sunday night in about ten minutes.
Thanks for watching, and subscribe if you want the template.
Next video covers taxes, which is a whole different beast.
